newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank says 15 pct ROE realistic.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank says 15 pct ROE realistic.

text.p: Commerzbank AG said on Tuesday it aimed to increase its return on equity to 15 percent after taxes or 25 percent before tax in what it called the medium term.
In the text of a speech prepared for delivery at a news conference, chief executive Martin Kohlhaussen said these goals were "ambitious but thoroughly realistic levels."
In order to achieve these goals, Kohlhaussen said, the bank would have to continue to use potential to cut costs and rationalise its branch network and exploit potential for increasing earnings.
Kohlhaussen also said that the bank had a declared goal to boost its capital ratios, if possible through its retained earnings.
Commerzbank's core capital ratio and its overall capital ration at year-end 1996 were 5.2 percent and 9.0 percent respectively, barely changed from the previous year.
